summary: Ready with caveats. Nothing blocks the build: there are no errors, all spec examples pass, and none of the 4 open questions or dev-refinement questions is marked blocking. Before refinement, the product owner should: (1) decide the Liechtenstein 'no liability' flow and what is recorded for it; (2) fix the Separated civil-status contradiction; (3) repair the rule rows that cite facts outside their cited set; (4) remove 4 small technical leaks from the spec text; (5) answer 7 major refinement questions (scope across customers, date rules, prefill of the first working day, saving and resuming, thresholds for mid-year starters, ownership of the reminder text). The child-tariff paths marked inferred and the questions for the pension fund stay as conditions before go-live.

findings.title: Liechtenstein 'no source tax liability' flow is undefined
findings.why: These employees may be asked tariff questions no one needs (against G-01), and it is unclear whether 'Subject to source tax' is recorded as yes or no. That changes what HR sees.
findings.evidence: dev_refinement (major) on US-05.7; AC-05.7.3 examples show '–' for denomination and children, but step 6 asks those questions before the Liechtenstein daily-return question.
findings.action: Add a decision to decisions.yaml: ask the Liechtenstein daily-return and 45-day questions first, skip the tariff questions when the result is 'no liability', and state the value recorded for 'Subject to source tax'.

findings.title: Separated civil status contradicts itself on the spouse's date of birth
findings.why: The fund registration for separated employees would be wrong either way.
findings.evidence: trace_judge rule.pension_fund_civil_status: D-003 says Married without the spouse's date of birth, but the Separated row asks for it. OQ-civil-status-partnership says 'both as Married with spouse/partner date of birth'.
findings.action: Make D-003, D-004, the rule row and the open-question text say the same thing. Keep the mapping as provisional until the fund confirms it.

findings.title: Rule rows cite facts outside their cited set
findings.why: These are traceability gaps: some outcome rows have no backing in the facts they cite.
findings.evidence: trace_judge rule.source_tax_result (b6d9b3), rule.cross_border_tariff_applies (bc1639, 52b67a), rule.single_parent_h_tariff (c78e0c), rule.source_tax_residence (Germany/Liechtenstein questions); US-04.2, US-05.4, US-06.1 and US-08.1 do not cite d7431e/b6d9b3; US-08.3 names the Julia incident without citing it.
findings.action: Add the missing fact references to the rules and stories, then rerun trace_judge.

findings.title: Child-tariff paths are inferred and the 'H tariff' purpose has no source
findings.why: Lonio now owns the tariff result, so an unverified path can produce a wrong tariff code.
findings.evidence: inferred_items: rule.child_tariff_result and US-06.2, 06.3, 06.5, 06.6; examples marked '(inferred, to verify)'; trace_judge on 8 child items (H tariff purpose); OQ-calculator-coverage; several partial fact_judge results on calculator facts (Q10, Q11, Q14 and Q15 labels).
findings.action: Keep D-009 as a go-live gate. A domain expert compares the computed codes with the calculator for every inferred row. Add a fact or decision that backs the H tariff purpose.

findings.title: Scope: Muster AG only, or every Lonio customer?
findings.why: This decides whether the fund field list, canton or calculator, and reminder text are hard-coded or set per customer.
findings.action: State the scope in feature.md, or record it as a decision. If the questionnaire serves every customer, list which parts each customer can set up.

findings.title: Technical decisions leak into the spec
findings.why: UI and modelling choices belong to engineering.
findings.evidence: tech_leak: information.md 'Country by English name…' and 'Expression describes one child'; US-02.1 'DD.MM.YYYY'; US-06.1 'add/remove a child, the child questions repeat'.
findings.action: Rewrite these as business needs: a country of residence, a date, facts collected per child. Keep DD.MM.YYYY only as the fund's output format.

findings.title: No date rules, and the first-working-day field is unclear
findings.why: The insurance start date is derived from unchecked dates, and it is unknown whether the first working day is prefilled by HR.
findings.evidence: dev_refinement (major) on information.md and US-02.1; coverage: F-pension_portal-3a97ab (how the insurance start date relates to the first working day) is not used anywhere in the spec.
findings.action: Decide the allowed ranges for the first working day and the dates of birth, and whether the first working day is prefilled and from where. Cite 3a97ab where the insurance start date is derived.

findings.title: Cross-border day thresholds for mid-year starters
findings.why: Using the full 60 or 45 days, or a pro-rated number, changes both the question wording and the tariff.
findings.evidence: dev_refinement (major) on US-07.2; there is also a minor question about 'not yet' versus 'no' for the certificate of residence.
findings.action: Get the rule from a domain expert and record it as a decision. Decide whether 'not yet' creates a follow-up for HR.

findings.title: Saving and resuming, and who owns the reminder text
findings.why: Both decide whether more features are in scope: saving answers, reminders, HR editing of text.
findings.evidence: dev_refinement (major) on feature.md (resume, deadline, reminders) and US-08.1 (HR wording of the permit reminder).
findings.action: Decide whether a saved draft and a deadline or reminder are in scope. Get one fixed reminder text from HR, or mark HR editing as excluded.

findings.title: Questions for the pension fund are still open
findings.why: The fund's required 'Canton' field, and any hidden field for divorced or widowed employees, could block a registration.
findings.evidence: OQ-canton-abroad (D-002), OQ-spouse-dob-other-status (D-004); fact_judge partial F-pension_portal-6d3630 and 39bab1.
findings.action: Ask Pensionskasse Muster to confirm what 'Canton' means and what to enter for employees abroad, and get screenshots for Divorced and Widowed. Close both before go-live.
